question: does the front control cluster wire each switch position to the function that position means
specification: DEVICE_SPEC.md 9: 'User buttons (6) SW2-SW7 ... UP / DOWN / LEFT / RIGHT / A_SELECT / B_BACK - FITTED - EXTERNAL (front) - MARKETING-SAFE (D-pad + A/B)'
mechanical/MECHANICAL_INTERFACE_SPEC.md 610: 'Front: Display/touch (upper), D-pad (lower left), A + B (lower right), microphone aperture (bottom)'
mechanical/P1_FLOORPLAN_INPUTS.md F-11: 'D-pad - 4 x PTS645SM43SMTR92LFS ... Front lower-left. LOCKED (part), arrangement TARGET'
CTO_DECISIONS D-012: 'Keep the D-pad.'  D-070: 'Front: display/touch, D-pad, A, B, mic aperture.  Six-face layout LOCKED.'

geometry.note: the board places six identical PTS645SM43SMTR92LFS in exactly the two clusters the spec names: a 15 mm diamond centred (13.500,115.000) lower-left, and a pair at y=99.000 lower-right.  y_mech = 148 - y_pcb, so larger y_mech is higher on the device; USB-C J3 at y_pcb 142.700 (y_mech 5.3) is the bottom edge and the display is upper.
geometry.corroboration: the LOCKED D-232 support ribs confirm which cluster is which: RIB_R1 (y_mech 24.00..44.00) and RIB_B1 (y_mech 21.20..23.30) bracket the diamond and are recorded as bracketing THE D-PAD; RIB_R2 (y_mech 45.00..64.00) is recorded as bearing behind THE A/B CONTROL AREA and the pair sits at y_mech 49.0

consequence: pressing the TOP of the D-pad sends DOWN; pressing its RIGHT arm sends A_SELECT; UP is a stray button 51 mm away beside B.  The device does not have a D-pad.

fix.shape: a pure 5-cycle of position AND rotation among six identical footprints
fix.why_free: every pad lands EXACTLY where an identical pad was, so courtyards, holes and the GND pad-2 lands are unchanged to the micron; only the pad-1 net identities move.  No schematic edit and no firmware constant changes -- each reference keeps its own function.
fix.placement_drc: real KiCad DRC on the corrected placement: {lib_footprint_issues: 199} and NOTHING ELSE -- zero clearance, zero shorts (evidence/d731-drc-dpad-placement.json)

routing_cost.best_measured: 4 of 5 re-lay (BTN_A_N 32.412 mm/4 vias, BTN_LEFT_N 94.133/5, BTN_DOWN_N 104.651/9, BTN_RIGHT_N 124.799/12); BTN_UP_N closes 2 of 3 joins and /01_POWER_TREE/BQ25185_SYS's pour is cut
routing_cost.verdict: THE CORRECTION DOES NOT ROUTE IN THE CURRENT FLOORPLAN
routing_cost.why: the correction puts FOUR ~40 mm hauls into the west-to-U2 corridor where the board previously carried THREE -- BTN_UP_N's switch was the one sitting beside U2.  The corridor holds N-1 of N.

u2_placement_score.method: total nearest-partner haul over U2's 19 netted signal pins, swept on a 2 mm lattice
u2_placement_score.reading: moving U2 west buys ~12.6 % of haul and is NOT on its own an unlock: the D-pad sits at x 6..21 and no reachable U2 position removes the four long hauls.
